summary: Equinor ASA filed a Form 6-K disclosing share buy-backs under a program announced Feb 4, 2026, running Feb 13, 2026 to Jan 15, 2027. The program authorizes up to NOK 1,971,000,000 in purchases (max 19.6M shares, with sub-limits). On June 15, 2026, Equinor bought 486,072 own shares at an average price of NOK 327.11 on Oslo Børs. Accumulated purchases total 2,532,334 shares at avg NOK 326.18. Post-transaction, Equinor holds 66,774,249 treasury shares (2.61% of capital). Shares are for employee incentive programs or capital reduction. No premium, advisor, or regulatory timeline; typical issuer buy-back for treasury.
